title: SplatLab: Autonomous Scientific Discovery for 3DGS Research
abstract: arXiv:2610.30468v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Scientific discovery requires more than generating hypotheses: ideas must be grounded in prior work, translated into executable methods, experimentally validated, challenged by counterevidence, and communicated through reproducible findings. Despite recent advances in autonomous research agents, closing this entire loop remains challenging in rapidly evolving computer-vision fields with complex training pipelines and expensive evaluations.   We introduce SplatLab, an autonomous scientific discovery system for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) that integrates literature understanding, hypothesis generation, implementation, experimental refinement, falsification, and manuscript writing into a unified research pipeline. Given a research prompt, a target-paper URL, or no input at all, SplatLab identifies research opportunities, proposes novel methods, trains and ablates candidates across Mip-NeRF 360 and LLFF, and produces manuscripts g

translated_title: SplatLab：面向3DGS研究的自主科学发现系统
translated_abstract: 科学发现不仅仅是生成假设：想法必须植根于已有工作，转化为可执行的方法，经过实验验证，接受反证的挑战，并通过可复现的发现进行交流。尽管自主研究智能体最近取得了进展，但在训练流程复杂、评估成本高昂的快速发展的计算机视觉领域，闭合这整个研究循环仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了SplatLab，一个面向三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）的自主科学发现系统，它将文献理解、假设生成、方法实现、实验改进、证伪和论文写作整合到统一的研究流程中。给定一个研究提示、一个目标论文的URL，或者完全无需输入，SplatLab能够识别研究机会、提出新颖的方法，在Mip-NeRF 360和LLFF数据集上训练候选方法并进行消融实验，并生成论文稿件。
tldr: SplatLab是一个面向3DGS领域的自主科学发现系统，它将文献理解、假设生成、方法实现、实验验证与证伪、以及论文写作整合为统一的研究流程，能够从少量甚至零输入出发自主完成从研究机会识别到论文产出的完整科研闭环。
en_tdlr: SplatLab is an autonomous scientific discovery system for 3DGS research that integrates literature understanding, hypothesis generation, implementation, experimental refinement, falsification, and manuscript writing into a unified pipeline, closing the full loop from research opportunity identification to paper production.
